info.name: FairShift PayPal Sandbox negative tests
info.description: PayPal Sandbox only. Test values from https://developer.paypal.com/api/payouts/v5/standard/test-go-live/ and https://developer.paypal.com/subscriptions/test-go-live. Requires Negative Testing On for the Sandbox business account; otherwise PayPal returns real Sandbox responses.

exec: pm.test('host is the PayPal Sandbox', () => pm.expect(pm.request.url.getHost()).to.eql('api-m.sandbox.paypal.com'));
pm.test('token HTTP ' + pm.response.code, () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(200));
const t = pm.response.json().access_token; pm.environment.set('access_token', t); pm.test('token returned', () => pm.expect(!!t).to.eql(true));
pm.test('host is the PayPal Sandbox', () => pm.expect(pm.request.url.getHost()).to.eql('api-m.sandbox.paypal.com'));
let body = {}; try { body = pm.response.json(); } catch (e) {}
const item = (body.items && body.items[0]) || {};
const name = body.name || (item.errors && item.errors.name) || (body.batch_header && body.batch_header.batch_status) || body.transaction_status || body.status || null;
const issue = (body.details && body.details[0] && body.details[0].issue) || item.transaction_status || null;
console.log(JSON.stringify({ code: 'ERRPYO005', expected: 'INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS', http: pm.response.code, name, issue, batchId: (body.batch_header && body.batch_header.payout_batch_id) || null }));
pm.test('ERRPYO005: PayPal answered (HTTP ' + pm.response.code + ', ' + name + ')', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.a('number'));
pm.test('host is the PayPal Sandbox', () => pm.expect(pm.request.url.getHost()).to.eql('api-m.sandbox.paypal.com'));
